module.name: Facilities
module.purpose: Defines the RTT Facilities domain — physical, operational, and communicative infrastructure governed across asset classes, lifecycle phases, audiences, and capital-timed modernization cycles.

session_context.format: html + markdown + playbooks + governance + scoring + diagrams

submodules.name: Asset Classes
submodules.purpose: Defines per-asset-class documentation for electrical, water, wastewater, transportation, communications, and public buildings.

submodules.name: City-Facing
submodules.purpose: Communication and briefing materials for city leadership and operational teams during modernization cycles.

submodules.name: Communications
submodules.purpose: Messaging guides, bibliographies, and RTT-AGERI communication artifacts for public and institutional audiences.

submodules.name: Dashboards
submodules.purpose: Dashboard mockups and visual index schemas for scoring, audit, and modernization tracking.

submodules.name: Design System
submodules.purpose: Governance, naming conventions, component standards, and style guides for all Facilities visual and structural artifacts.

submodules.name: Governance
submodules.purpose: Global governance constitutions, charters, escalation pathways, and accountability structures for GHQ-grade facilities oversight.

submodules.name: Operators
submodules.purpose: Orientation, maintenance standards, and modernization handoff protocols for operators and contractors.

submodules.name: Research
submodules.purpose: RTT-AGERI bibliography, research references, and validation resources grounding the Facilities domain.

submodules.name: Residents
submodules.purpose: Public-facing education, storm-season safety, FAQ materials, and RTT-AGERI explainers for residents.

submodules.name: Strategy
submodules.purpose: Long-horizon planning — global modernization timelines, 2050 strategy, and visual storyboards for capital-timed facilities evolution.
